mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_session (conversation_id, title, message_count) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{title}, #{messageCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, title, message_count, created_at, updated_at FROM assistant_session ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_session SET title = #{title} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
UPDATE assistant_session SET message_count = message_count + #{delta} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
